info.name: FHIR Terminology Service
info.description:
Example requests for the Ballerina FHIR R4 Terminology Service.

1. Start the service (default `http://localhost:9090`). If it runs elsewhere, change the `baseUrl` collection variable.
2. **00 Try It Without Uploads** works straight away against the ~500 built-in CodeSystems loaded at startup.
3. For SNOMED CT, LOINC and ICD-10-CM, run **01 Load Terminology** for the content you have (SNOMED CT and ICD-10-CM load in the background - wait for the completion log).
4. Run **02 Create Example Resources** once.
5. Try any request in folders 03-06.

item.name: 00 Try It Without Uploads
item.description:
Works on a fresh server with nothing uploaded. On startup the service loads about 500 built-in CodeSystems (FHIR R4 `http://hl7.org/fhir/...` and HL7 Terminology `http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/...`), and these requests use them.

Only CodeSystems are preloaded, not ValueSets, so the ValueSet examples pass an inline ValueSet in the request body.

request.description: Expected `result: true`.
Expected `result: false`.
`unconfirmed` has two children, `provisional` and `differential`, returned as `child` properties.
Expected `outcome: subsumes`.
Expected `outcome: not-subsumed`.
Expands to all four AdministrativeGender codes.

item.name: Expand inline ValueSet with is-a filter

request.description: Expands to `unconfirmed` and its descendants.
Expected `result: true`.
Adds two concepts to the closure table `builtin-closure-demo` and returns the subsumption pair between them. Closure tables persist on the server, so running this again returns no new pairs.

item.name: 01 Load Terminology ($upload)
item.description:
Bulk-load terminology content from zip archives. The `x-terminology-type` header selects the importer. Run whichever ones you have content for; the rest of the collection uses SNOMED CT, LOINC and ICD-10-CM codes.

LOINC, SNOMED CT and ICD-10-CM releases are licensed content and must be obtained from their publishers.

request.description:
Upload a zip of FHIR `CodeSystem-*.json` / `ValueSet-*.json` files. Loaded synchronously.

In the **Body** tab, select the release zip (no file is bundled with this collection). The `$` must be sent percent-encoded as `%24upload` - see the README.

Upload a LOINC release zip. Converted to a FHIR CodeSystem and loaded synchronously. `loinc-version` is optional.

In the **Body** tab, select the release zip (no file is bundled with this collection). The `$` must be sent percent-encoded as `%24upload` - see the README.

Upload a SNOMED CT RF2 **Snapshot** zip. `snomed-version` is the RF2 release date (`YYYYMMDD`).

Returns `201` once the archive is extracted; the import continues in the background and takes several minutes. Watch the server logs for the completion summary.

In the **Body** tab, select the release zip (no file is bundled with this collection). The `$` must be sent percent-encoded as `%24upload` - see the README.

Upload a zip containing `icd10cm-tabular-<year>.xml` and `icd10cm-order-<year>.txt`. Imported in the background like SNOMED CT; a concurrent ICD-10-CM upload returns `409`.

In the **Body** tab, select the release zip (no file is bundled with this collection). The `$` must be sent percent-encoded as `%24upload` - see the README.

item.name: $lookup
item.description: Look up a code's display, designations and properties. For SNOMED CT this includes parents, children and attribute relationships.
